unit.mapping: 1:1 at same logical width; map path uses filletRadiusMeters (raised so 2.5m cap no longer blocks pt-scale fillets)

notes: Render-only fillet at sharp vertices. Stored GPS / distance metrics must not change. Apply after stretch-split so casing→fill z-order and stretch boundaries use smoothed coords. v2: minTurn 30° + circular arc (not quadratic-through-apex) so curve3 (~42° adjacent, short legs) cuts the tip visibly under 40% along cap.
methodNotes: At vertex B with turn ≥ minTurnDegrees: cut T1/T2 along adjacent edges by along=min(r/tan(θ/2), maxFilletAlongPt, maxAlongSegmentFraction·segLen); replace B with circular-arc samples T1→T2 (arcSamples interior, G1). Quadratic-through-apex hugs mid-sharp tips — do not use. Straight / very gentle turns keep the vertex.
